namespace go demo
/* A person. */
struct Person {
  1: required string name,
  2: optional i32 age = 30,
  3: list<string> emails,
}
exception NotFound { 1: string message }
service Greeter extends Base {
  string greet(1: Person who) throws (1: NotFound err),
  oneway void ping()
}
